title: "Attracting Torus System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y\\
\dot{y} &=& -x-zy\\
\dot{z} &=& y^2+a+bz
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-4,b=0.1$ and initial condition $(0,2,1)$.
